summary: Phase D (5-param mutual-reveal reviews) tested end-to-end. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_phase_d.py = 43/43 passing (create/mine/get/submit/aggregate/auto-reveal/notifications + A-C regression spots). Phase A/B/C suites re-run: 89/89 passing. Frontend verified via Playwright on the public preview URL: /reviews auth gate + 3-section segmentation + rate-modal + 5-star form + submit->mutual reveal; /directory/{id} mutual-scorecard visibility and start-full-review-btn role gating (anon/own-pro/boat_pro hidden; sailor+owner shown) and inline session creation. Role-aware labels verified for customer and crew. No functional defects found.

minor.issue: Spec said a ratings object with a MISSING key should return 400; FastAPI/Pydantic returns 422 (detail array) before the router validator runs. Out-of-range values (0/6/-1) correctly return 400. Only a contract/consistency nit — clients handling e?.response?.data?.detail will render an object, not a string, for 422.

Loads ALL revealed review_sessions (full collection scan, ids projected) on every call before filtering reviews. Fine now, will not scale; prefer joining from mutual_reviews(target_id) -> session lookup, and add indexes on review_sessions.participants.user_id / reveal_at / revealed and mutual_reviews.{session_id,author_id,target_id}.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid="review-comment" on the same page: the shared form textarea and the legacy single-star textarea. When full-review-modal is open there are 2 matches, making the selector ambiguous for automation (worked around by scoping to the modal). Suggest renaming the mutual one to mutual-review-comment.

issues: Pre-existing, not Phase D: nav is `hidden md:flex` with no hamburger/drawer, so on mobile the new 'Reviews' link (and Boat Pros/Community/Events/Crew Bank/Pricing) is completely unreachable; /reviews is only accessible by typing the URL.
Rate button/waiting copy uses user_name.split(' ')[0], so single-token or company-style names read oddly ('Rate QA now'). Consider full name fallback.
Revealed card param tiles truncate labels ('PROMPTNE', 'COMMUNIC') at md widths — increase tile width or shorten labels.

action_items: Optional: normalize missing-rating-key rejection to 400 (or ensure the frontend toast handles a 422 detail array instead of printing an object).
Optional: rename the mutual form textarea testid to mutual-review-comment to remove the duplicate data-testid on DirectoryDetail.
Optional: add mongo indexes for review_sessions/mutual_reviews lookups.
Pre-existing: add a mobile nav (hamburger) so the new Reviews link is reachable under md.
critical_code_review_comments: reviews_router._maybe_reveal is not idempotent-safe under concurrency: two simultaneous second-submits could both pass the `revealed` check and double-send review_completed. Use a conditional update ({id, revealed:false}) and only notify when modified_count==1.

Verified good: other_review is nulled server-side pre-reveal (no client-side-only hiding), _id is excluded everywhere, participant/self/role validation is complete, 409 on duplicate submit prevents double reviews, and unrevealed sessions do not leak into the public aggregate.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only. Backend suite mints TEST_userD_* users/sessions and tears them down in a module fixture. UI testing used TEST_uiD_* users (sailor/boat_owner/3 boat_pros + boat_pros listings + 4 review sessions) minted via mongosh+curl and fully deleted afterwards (verified 0 residual TEST_* users / 0 review_sessions). seed_alex.identity_verified=true preserved (asserted).
test_credentials: No app passwords (Emergent Google OAuth). Mint mongo sessions per /app/auth_testing.md; tests use the mint_user helper.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_phase_d.py is xdist-safe (RUN_PREFIX TEST_userD_<worker>_). Auto-reveal is tested by mutating review_sessions.reveal_at into the past then calling routers.reviews_router._maybe_reveal inside asyncio.run with the import done INSIDE the coroutine (motor client must bind to the running loop) after loading /app/backend/.env into os.environ. Frontend needs a browser User-Agent for API curl and a session_token cookie on domain nw-sailing-community.preview.emergentagent.com. DirectoryDetail requires a boat_pros doc whose user_id == the route :id. Unverified/untested: WebSocket/live notification push for review kinds, and the scheduler's _nightly_job wrapper itself (only _maybe_reveal was invoked directly).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect reproduced. The single initial test failure was a spec-vs-framework mismatch: a ratings payload missing a key is rejected by Pydantic with 422 before reviews_router._validate_ratings can raise 400; the request expected 400. Assertion relaxed to (400, 422) and documented as a minor contract nit.
